dialogues.speaker: Vino
variants: I can smell the heavy sea salt... and feel a chilling breeze. We have entered a forgotten memory world.
The salt air is thick here, and the wind carries a quiet sadness. We've stepped into a memory frozen in time.
This shore feels so familiar, yet hollow. The memory of this village is fading fast.
Cold wind... smelling of dried fish and wet sand. A memory world lies right before us.
The fog hangs heavy over the water. We are inside the lost memory of an old coastal barangay.

dialogues.speaker: Echo
variants: This is Mang Tomas' memory, Vino. A coastal world frozen in time. The black fog of oblivion hides his story.
You stand in the past of Mang Tomas, an old fisherman. Time stopped here the day he sailed into the storm.
Mang Tomas' life is trapped in these fading shores. Shadows of oblivion have covered the truth of who he was.
These fragmented shores belong to Mang Tomas. The village remembers his disappearance, but forgot his heart.
An old fisherman's soul left these echoes behind. The dark fog obscures the sacrifices he made for his family.

dialogues.speaker: Vino
variants: I must look for clues and talk to the villagers to reconstruct the truth of his life.
I need to gather the scattered pieces of his past. The ordinary people here hold the key.
To uncover what truly happened to Mang Tomas, I will listen closely to the memories of his neighbors.
Every forgotten keepsake in this village has a voice. I will seek out his story.
He wasn't a famous man, but his memory matters. Let's hear what his community remembers.
